summary: A 43-year-old man was shot multiple times in Jakkalsvlei Avenue, Bonteheuwel, at about 23:06 on Tuesday 6 October and declared dead at the scene; police opened a murder case and made no arrests (Daily Voice, quoting poli...
story: A 43-year-old man was shot multiple times in Jakkalsvlei Avenue, Bonteheuwel, at about 23:06 on Tuesday 6 October and declared dead at the scene; police opened a murder case and made no arrests (Daily Voice, quoting police spokesperson Wesley Twigg). The ward councillor said it appeared gang-related.
